BCI Group 31 Truck Batteries

DINWEY BCI Group 31 heavy-duty truck batteries — the North American standard for commercial vehicles, off-highway equipment and fleet trucks. Diesel-grade cold cranking amps with threaded or SAE terminals.

Typical Applications

  • Class 7–8 heavy-duty trucks
  • Off-highway and construction equipment
  • Bus and coach starting
  • Fleet vehicles and reefer units

Frequently Asked Questions

Is Group 31 the standard truck battery?

Yes — BCI Group 31 is the most common heavy-duty truck battery size in North America, widely used in Class 7–8 trucks and off-highway equipment.

Can I wire two Group 31 batteries for 24V?

Yes. Two 12V Group 31 batteries wired in series provide the 24V used by many heavy trucks and semi trailers.

Do you offer Group 31 in AGM?

Yes. Group 31 is available in flooded, EFB and AGM technologies depending on duty cycle and vibration requirements.
